content.text: Provider is set at registration or confirm.

candidates.explanation: When createUserDto.provider is not supplied (as in email registration, which doesn't pass a provider), the provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google. The newly registered user is stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then sees user.provider !== email and throws 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.

fix.description: Default the provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email instead of google.
